profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: My passion is creating distributed applications that serve millions of users. Equipped with 8+ years in software engineering, I am capable of designing, implementing and scaling enterprise services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Apache Spark · Elasticsearch · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Design, write and review code solutions for the Search team, using Java, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, Tensorflow Models and AWS.

• Owner of the menu item service, collaborating with product managers, data scientists and global engineering teams on new features. Compose and approve technical RFC and architecture documents.

• Write Spark jobs in Scala to process terabytes of data for faster hydration of search responses.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
• Developing and designing a distributed data lake with a REST API interface, utilizing software such as Java, Spring, Apache Kafka and Apache Storm.

• Configuring and maintaining different data stores, such as Elasticsearch, Vertica and Amazon S3, to allow optimal data ingestion and retrieval of terabytes of structured and unstructured data.

• Maintained JUnit test coverage of at least 80% and created integration tests with Cucumber for a robust back-end code base.

• Building a web application with Angular 9, Karma unit tests and Cypress integration tests that allows users to create custom schema in the data lake, analyze ingested data and control access with roles. 

• Supervised interns and new developers, aided them with technical onboarding and conducted code reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Designed and developed the Spring Boot micro-service, “MyAdhoc Tasks”, an API to improve task management within the organization.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description:
•	Assist college students in Calculus and CIS 101, which teaches Microsoft Excel 2013 and web development.
•	Offer collegians encouragement and effective studying techniques.

educations.schoolName: Pace University - Seidenberg School of Computer Science and Information Systems

volunteerExperiences.description: For over 90 years, ABPS has provided community and assistance to Antiguans living in New York City and those back home. I made executive decisions and improved the charity’s technological processes (i.e. launched new website)

organizations.name: FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC)
organizations.position: Lead Scorekeeper & General Volunteer · Feb 2016 - Jan 2020
organizations.description: FTC is a national robotics competition for high-school students.
